title: Facilities: renew your badge details here
scenario: An email styled like Facilities says your access badge is expiring and asks you to confirm your employee ID and a photo of your badge on a linked renewal site to avoid being locked out of the building.

answers.A: Confirm the details on the site to avoid losing building access.
answers.B: Confirm the details, and also photograph your badge as asked.
answers.C: Check badge renewal directly with Facilities or Security in person or through a known internal system.

explanation: Physical access-credential phishing collects exactly what's needed to clone a badge or impersonate an employee at the door, dressed up as routine building admin.
proTip: Badge and access changes go through Facilities or Security directly, not a link that emailed you.
